Our approach / Ember & Ink

THE WHOLE MEAL.
The whole story.

KBBQGuide is a collection of 80 recipes for Korean barbecue and the food around it. The grill is the beginning. The rest of the table matters just as much.

Know the tradition

ROOTED.
Still growing.

The collection keeps its original labels—heritage, restaurant, diaspora, and contemporary—so you can see which kind of cooking each recipe represents.

Heritage

Recipes rooted in the household table, fermentation, and the small dishes that support the meal.

Explore heritage recipes ↗

Restaurant

The grill hall, the tabletop, and the dishes shaped by eating together in Korean restaurants.

Explore restaurant recipes ↗

Diaspora

The Korean-American chapter, including the distinctive cut and marinade of LA-style galbi.

Explore diaspora recipes ↗

Contemporary

New combinations and adaptations, identified clearly alongside the other traditions.

Explore contemporary recipes ↗

A note on the collection

This edition restores the saved, AI-generated recipe imagery and presents the existing recipe collection in a new design. Selected images have been refined to match the written ingredients and preparation more closely. Follow the written ingredients, methods, and checkpoints for each dish. Images illustrate the recipes and do not imply independent kitchen testing.

For more ways with Korean pantry ingredients, visit our companion site, Gochujang — The Seoul Table.
